cohort: 243,682 newborns at a large tertiary medical centre between 1991 and 2014, excluding those with congenital malformations and multiple gestations
finding: Offspring of mothers with HBV or HCV carrier status had a higher incidence of neurological hospitalisations.
mod_finding: This study controlled for mode of delivery as a confounding variable when assessing the association between maternal HBV/HCV carrier status and long-term offspring neurological hospitalizations, but it did not examine mode of delivery as a primary focus.
